name: GatherHQ
long_description:
Gather's long horizon agent serves enterprise GTM teams by continually interviewing real buyers and turning what it learned into content that drives pipeline and simulations that predict customer behavior.

More than 65 enterprise marketing teams, including Envoy, Eclypsium, Cover Genius, Fortinet, CoStar, Bagel Brands, and Family Express, use Gather to continually fight AI slop and create original on-brand, third-party validated thought leadership, reports, ebooks, and campaign content.

The value of that research compounds. Every interview adds to a foundation of quantitative, qualitative, and voice data from over 300,000 real interviews across customers, with thousands added monthly. Our models use that understanding to predict how buyers will respond to messaging, pricing, and market shifts. Each answer includes supporting evidence and a confidence level. When confidence is low, Gather automatically runs new research.

Gather starts by replacing research firms and content agencies, and we aspire to build the real-time customer understanding layer that enterprises will use to drive decisions.

Built by the team that created Cooliris (acquired by Yahoo) and Pulse (acquired by Gartner), and ran Gartner Peer Insights.
one_liner: Applied AI for Enterprise GTM (3X founders, 10X growth, backed by ANT)
